fig_intervention_decision.webp.caption: Base: 41,610 included records; intervention rows use the included records within each class. Primary intervention class only; residual Other omitted. All columns use the full row denominator, including records with an unavailable flag; model-based is the share positively identified as model-based. Signals are abstract keyword flags, not a full-text quality assessment. "Not reported" does not mean "not done".
